entities.name: Josef Horešovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Horešovský was a Czech professional ice hockey player and coach, who played in the Czechoslovak Extraliga. He played for HC Dukla Jihlava and HC Sparta Praha. Horešovský won a silver medal at the 1968 Winter Olympics and a bronze medal at the 1972 Winter Olympics.
